title: raw-native: build, render, check
subtitle: a walkthrough of the first run

steps.say: Configure the build with CMake. raw-native needs a C++23 compiler and nothing else.
Build it: the renderer, its tests and the command-line tool.
Render the default scene. It writes the frame, the ambient occlusion maps and a certificate with a verdict.
Check the certificate from the files the render wrote.
And check it again with a second checker in Python that shares no code with the first.
